description: This file defines the ServiceSpecificConfig interface which provides common configuration settings for Ditto services. It extends other configuration interfaces and declares methods to retrieve LimitsConfig and HttpConfig instances.

classes.name: ServiceSpecificConfig
classes.description: An interface that provides access to common configuration settings for Ditto services, including limits and HTTP configuration. It also extends clustering and metrics configuration interfaces.

methods.name: getLimitsConfig
methods.description: Returns the LimitsConfig object that contains configuration related to limits for the service.

methods.name: getHttpConfig
methods.description: Returns the HttpConfig object that provides HTTP-related configuration details.
